Calibration limits

The declared surrogate budget has a minimum empirical p-value of 0.0153846; the campaign screening cutoff is 0.00208333. This preliminary budget cannot clear that cutoff. It must not yield a discovery-significance claim. Surrogate searches are only run for otherwise promising, noncatalogued candidates that survive independent testing. An omitted calibration is not a passing test.

Agent-led exploratory tests

These proposals, code and interpretations are recorded separately. This campaign records 2 successful sandboxed code experiments. {
  "arguments": {
    "code": "import json\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.stats import chi2\n\nwith np.load('/input/lightcurve.npz', allow_pickle=False) as data:\n    t = np.asarray(data['time'], dtype=float)\n    f = np.asarray(data['flux'], dtype=float)\n    e = np.asarray(data['flux_err'], dtype=float)\nvalid = np.isfinite(t) & np.isfinite(f) & np.isfinite(e) & (e > 0)\nt, f, e = t[valid], f[valid], e[valid]\nperiod, epoch, duration = 4.62568669403805, 1325.3646656488213, 0.12\nnumbers = [0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6]\n\ndef weighted_mean(x, err):\n    w = 1.0 / err**2\n    return float(np.sum(w * x) / np.sum(w)), float(np.sqrt(1.0 / np.sum(w)))\n\nrows = []\nfor n in numbers:\n    dt = t - (epoch + n * period)\n    inside = np.abs(dt) <= duration / 2\n    baseline = (np.abs(dt) >= 0.12) & (np.abs(dt) <= 0.30)\n    if inside.sum() < 5 or baseline.sum() < 5:\n        continue\n    fi, si = weighted_mean(f[inside], e[inside])\n    fo, so = weighted_mean(f[baseline], e[baseline])\n    depth = (fo - fi) / fo\n    uncertainty = np.sqrt(si**2 + (fi * so / fo)**2) / abs(fo)\n    if np.isfinite(depth) and np.isfinite(uncertainty) and uncertainty > 0:\n        rows.append((n, int(inside.sum()), depth, uncertainty))\n\nout = {'events_measured': len(rows), 'events': [{'number': n, 'n_in': count, 'depth': round(d, 8), 'depth_error': round(s, 8)} for n, count, d, s in rows]}\nif len(rows) >= 2:\n    depths = np.array([r[2] for r in rows])\n    errors = np.array([r[3] for r in rows])\n    weights = 1 / errors**2\n    mean_depth = np.sum(weights * depths) / np.sum(weights)\n    statistic = float(np.sum(((depths - mean_depth) / errors)**2))\n    p_value = float(chi2.sf(statistic, len(rows) - 1))\n    out.update(mean_depth=round(float(mean_depth), 8), heterogeneity_chi2=round(statistic, 4), degrees_of_freedom=len(rows)-1, heterogeneity_p=round(p_value, 8), inconsistent_at_0_01=bool(p_value < 0.01))\nprint(json.dumps(out, allow_nan=False))",
    "tic": "25079777"
  },

      "code": "import json\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.stats import chi2\n\nwith np.load('/input/lightcurve.npz', allow_pickle=False) as data:\n    t = np.asarray(data['time'], dtype=float)\n    f = np.asarray(data['flux'], dtype=float)\n    e = np.asarray(data['flux_err'], dtype=float)\nvalid = np.isfinite(t) & np.isfinite(f) & np.isfinite(e) & (e > 0)\nt, f, e = t[valid], f[valid], e[valid]\nperiod, epoch, duration = 4.62568669403805, 1325.3646656488213, 0.12\nnumbers = [0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6]\n\ndef weighted_mean(x, err):\n    w = 1.0 / err**2\n    return float(np.sum(w * x) / np.sum(w)), float(np.sqrt(1.0 / np.sum(w)))\n\nrows = []\nfor n in numbers:\n    dt = t - (epoch + n * period)\n    inside = np.abs(dt) <= duration / 2\n    baseline = (np.abs(dt) >= 0.12) & (np.abs(dt) <= 0.30)\n    if inside.sum() < 5 or baseline.sum() < 5:\n        continue\n    fi, si = weighted_mean(f[inside], e[inside])\n    fo, so = weighted_mean(f[baseline], e[baseline])\n    depth = (fo - fi) / fo\n    uncertainty = np.sqrt(si**2 + (fi * so / fo)**2) / abs(fo)\n    if np.isfinite(depth) and np.isfinite(uncertainty) and uncertainty > 0:\n        rows.append((n, int(inside.sum()), depth, uncertainty))\n\nout = {'events_measured': len(rows), 'events': [{'number': n, 'n_in': count, 'depth': round(d, 8), 'depth_error': round(s, 8)} for n, count, d, s in rows]}\nif len(rows) >= 2:\n    depths = np.array([r[2] for r in rows])\n    errors = np.array([r[3] for r in rows])\n    weights = 1 / errors**2\n    mean_depth = np.sum(weights * depths) / np.sum(weights)\n    statistic = float(np.sum(((depths - mean_depth) / errors)**2))\n    p_value = float(chi2.sf(statistic, len(rows) - 1))\n    out.update(mean_depth=round(float(mean_depth), 8), heterogeneity_chi2=round(statistic, 4), degrees_of_freedom=len(rows)-1, heterogeneity_p=round(p_value, 8), inconsistent_at_0_01=bool(p_value < 0.01))\nprint(json.dumps(out, allow_nan=False))",

    "result": {
      "code": "import json\nimport numpy as np\n\nwith np.load('/input/lightcurve.npz', allow_pickle=False) as data:\n    t = np.asarray(data['time'], dtype=float)\n    f = np.asarray(data['flux'], dtype=float)\n    e = np.asarray(data['flux_err'], dtype=float)\nvalid = np.isfinite(t) & np.isfinite(f) & np.isfinite(e) & (e > 0)\nt, f, e = t[valid], f[valid], e[valid]\nperiod, epoch, duration = 4.62568669403805, 1325.3646656488213, 0.12\nnumbers = [0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6]\n\nrows = []\nfor n in numbers:\n    dt = t - (epoch + n * period)\n    inside = np.abs(dt) <= duration / 2\n    outside = (np.abs(dt) >= 0.12) & (np.abs(dt) <= 0.30)\n    if inside.sum() < 5 or outside.sum() < 5:\n        continue\n    baseline = np.median(f[outside])\n    scale = 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(f[outside] - baseline))\n    if not np.isfinite(scale) or scale <= 0:\n        continue\n    kept = inside & (np.abs(f - baseline) <= 4 * scale)\n    rows.append({'number': n, 'baseline': baseline, 'inside': inside, 'kept': kept, 'scale': scale})\n\ndef pooled_depth(clipped):\n    numer = 0.0\n    denom = 0.0\n    count = 0\n    for row in rows:\n        mask = row['kept'] if clipped else row['inside']\n        w = 1 / e[mask]**2\n        numer += float(np.sum(w * (row['baseline'] - f[mask]) / row['baseline']))\n        denom += float(np.sum(w))\n        count += int(mask.sum())\n    return (numer / denom if denom > 0 else None), count\n\noriginal, n_original = pooled_depth(False)\nclipped, n_clipped = pooled_depth(True)\nreduction = (1 - clipped / original) if original is not None and clipped is not None and original > 0 else None\nout = {'events_used': len(rows), 'in_transit_points': n_original, 'points_removed': n_original - n_clipped, 'original_pooled_depth': original, 'clipped_pooled_depth': clipped, 'fractional_depth_reduction': reduction, 'undermines_interpretation': bool(reduction is not None and (reduction > 0.5 or clipped <= 0))}\nprint(json.dumps(out, allow_nan=False))",
